description: This file defines a class `Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Dq`, which models the parse tree for double-quoted strings inside Smarty template tags. It manages subtrees representing parts of the string, allows appending new subtrees, merging their content into executable PHP code, and tracks parsing context such as block nesting levels. The class is part of the Smarty template engine's internal compilation system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Dq
classes.description: Represents a parse tree node for double-quoted strings within Smarty template tags, managing subtrees and generating PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parse tree with a subtree and adjusts parser nesting level if the subtree is a tag.

methods.name: append_subtree
methods.description: Appends a new subtree to the current parse tree, wrapping data in PHP echo statements based on subtree type.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Compiles the entire subtree collection into a PHP code string, concatenating parts and managing variable string flags.
